project_type: Python FastAPI + React TypeScript - Football Intelligence Platform
build_system: Python virtual environment (.venv), pip for backend; npm for frontend
test_framework: pytest with pytest-asyncio for backend tests
build_command: No build step for Python backend (interpreted)
verification_instructions: Run pytest for full test suite. Verify 974+ tests pass with 0 failures. Use --tb=short for concise tracebacks. Run specific test files with path: pytest tests/test_file.py::TestClass::test_method
environment_constraints: Python virtual environment at backend/.venv must be activated using .venv\Scripts\python.exe (Windows). Never use global python. Backend runs on http://127.0.0.1:8000 (do not restart unless explicitly needed). Tests use development provider with deterministic mock data.
contribution_requirements: From AGENTS.md: Always inspect files before editing (Rule 2). Never delete working code without justification (Rule 3). Work in small verifiable steps (Rule 4). Run tests after every meaningful change (Rule 6). Never claim 'implemented' or 'tested' unless verified (Rule 7). Keep mock data labeled as DEVELOPMENT (Rule 8-9). Never invent statistics, probabilities, or model results (Rule 10-11). AI Analyst must not modify numerical values (Rule 13). Update docs/PROGRESS.md after completion (Rule 25).
key_patterns: Backend uses Pydantic for validation, dataclasses for domain models, and dependency injection. Models implement PredictionModel interface with check_availability() and predict() methods. Tests use fixtures (pytest) and mock providers. All code identifiers in English, UI text in Turkish. Canonical pipeline: FeatureSnapshot → ModelOrchestrator → Ensemble → Calibration → Confidence → Markets → Selector → Versioning.
directory_structure: backend/ contains app/ (source) and tests/. app/ organized by domain: prediction/ (models, orchestration, ensemble, calibration, confidence, market derivation, versioning), providers/ (data sources), domain/ (entities, schemas), api/ (FastAPI endpoints), features/ (feature extraction). Tests mirror app structure.
